teaser: Checking twice is cheap insurance, and life path 6 built out of ESTJ letters checks three times before anyone else notices a gap. The 6 carries a built-in sense of duty toward whoever is nearby — the home, the team, the people counting on dinner being on the table at six. ESTJ brings the discipline to make that duty into a working system: lists kept, promises kept, nothing left loose. Crossed, the two don't argue so much as compete for who gets to be in charge of caring. What is particular here is a kind of loving administration — affection delivered as logistics, dependable as a timetable.
